title: Conditional κ = 0.003643716168305 (+2.77661886e-7 over #7145): temporal chart-595 split
body:
This adds one source-bound temporal helper split to the complete #7145 construction, raising conditional **κ to 0.003643716168305**, **+0.000000277661886 over #7145**. At frame 595, six timed gathers and four later injections give exact helper vectors with **c d = 1** (42 and 353 nonzero coordinates). Retirement at cut 38,883 splits productive rank nine into one and eight. One paid path on role 757 changes rank two into one plus one; nine neutral paths and two new owned buffers are explicit.

Concurrent [draft #7147](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7147) at `4ca446706d4106176486235b9d7c66bd301b72ff` reports the higher preliminary κ = 0.003643989339627 from a different frame-237 split on the same #7145 source. At the 01:28:59 UTC snapshot, its forward/grid, physical, full caller and registered checks remained pending. This package supplies a distinct complete frame-595 result; it does not claim the strongest open headline. Composition of the two changes has not been tested.

The initial word contained four ADD coefficients with 25-bit numerators. Each is replaced by two exact additions, **preserving the inherited 24-bit compiler assertion** and charging four extra operations. The original native run was interrupted before completion; all final receipts use the normalized word. Native delta: **ΔP = {1:+2, 2:−1}; ΔT = {1:+1, 8:+1, 9:−1}**, with both rank masses unchanged. Total added work is **815 ADDs, four SCALEs, one MOVE, two INITs and two CLEARs**. The final word has **76,150 events**, 1,496 public fields, 1,096 helpers and **57 owned labels / 60 lifetimes / peak 45**.

The unchanged 17-stage caller has **110,468 paid positions**, **22,376 productive fields**, surplus **1,424**, zero empty credit, ordinary source-unit work **781,483,168 < 10⁹**, and fresh precision **c = 2430** on grid **1125/F25**. All 969 owned banks, long buffer lifetimes and scalar costs are charged. The directed invoice crossing lies strictly in `(0.0036437161683053639514518829222626, 0.0036437161683053639514518829222627)`. The unchanged BIT cap leaves 0.000122973831695 headroom; this is not a global-optimality claim. The discovery search stopped at its first positive after 4,250 of 7,660 paths, leaving the rest unprocessed.

All three direct CPython 3.14.7 commands and all three registered isolated CPython 3.12.16 commands passed, matching every frozen receipt field; all **29 scientific hashes** stayed unchanged. Coverage includes exact source and timed-vector reconstruction, whole forward/adjoint and COPY/ownership checks, **18 native controls** (including ten certificate controls), five sets of 512 Gaussian chart/phase columns, finite physical routes, all **3,038 paid/helper maps and 104 main boundaries**, fresh ordinary/owned-stock/grid/envelope/fixed-tape costs, both prices, and **54 strict + 4 functional outer conditions**. These are finite source-bound checks; the inherited framework assumptions below remain.

```sh
git fetch --no-tags https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git main
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-temporal-chart595-split
```

Inputs are complete #7145 at `db8f31c4a1d9e191976e2c92951e6d2dea886a27` (33 files) and #7143 at `9ff298bd6547299dc5b263873bf8a400909e5501` (31 files), including all nested sources and notices. Six implementations remain byte-identical under `REUSE.json`; the retained constructor is explicitly renamed `temporal_construct.py`. Final native SHA256: `ecb1f56ba06dbaae424d0f94ad41c6d08f39f5f1f2fec348f2d0c9c9873c657f`. `PROOF.md`, `APPLICATION.md`, `VALIDATION.md`, `NORMALIZATION.json` and `REPLAY.txt` give the exact scope and evidence.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

Five inherited assumptions (`native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`), independent human/formal acceptance, maintainer admission and compiled top-level execution remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged. Hosted CI is separate from local replay.

Chris R/Clear1nsight's now-closed two-paid-path screen and new rank-eight partial-boundary scope on #7145 and ToikY's caller/BIT work remain distinct and credited.
